l6.crc_formula: ceil(4 x expected_total / 1000) (D-s4), from the instrument's l6_schedule
l6.transport_disposition: One explicitly authorized B3Q attempt as a bounded exception to the standing CH340 single-byte-deletion transport stop-loss; no general release.
l6.deadline_formula: 1.25 x records x 3600 / rate_for_split + 600 (rate_for_split = 0.85 x the B3Q-measured rate)

deadline_rate.source: the pinned B3Q planning bound (never a calibration)
deadline_rate.rule: the slowest archived observed all-self-reporting rate (B2 session 1); B3Q MEASURES the real one

clocks.wall: time.time() on the host, seconds since the epoch
clocks.resolution_s: one runner poll interval (~0.02 s): every line a poll returned shares its stamp
